aiVerification.summary: The draft correctly identifies the comparable JIG TEST vs JIG Normal condition and improvement direction, but needs citation cleanup before final Ask AI use.

The VP+CD table row values appear internally odd because Input 151, OK 151, and NG 16 do not reconcile, although the NG rate matches 16/151 and the improvement judgement remains supported.

Add 201507!28 to the evidence for the function outcome.
Optionally add row 201507!24 as the VP+CD table header citation if retaining Input/OK/NG/NG Rate field interpretation.
